items.question: Trong câu "A delivery team is not a uniform block.", từ "delivery" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A delivery team is not a uniform block.", what does "delivery" (noun) mean?
options: việc làm ra và bàn giao sản phẩm
optionsEn: building and handing over a product
the manner of giving a speech
items.explanation: delivery /dɪˈlɪv.ər.i/ (danh từ): việc làm ra và bàn giao sản phẩm. "Delivery team" = đội trực tiếp làm ra và bàn giao sản phẩm (BA, dev, tester); "on-time delivery" = bàn giao đúng hạn.
items.explanationEn: delivery /dɪˈlɪv.ər.i/ (noun): building and handing over a product. A "delivery team" builds and ships the product (BA, developers, testers); "on-time delivery" means shipping by the deadline.

items.question: Trong câu "A delivery team is not a uniform block.", từ "uniform" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A delivery team is not a uniform block.", what does "uniform" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uniform /ˈjuː.nɪ.fɔːm/ (tính từ): đồng nhất, như nhau. "Not a uniform block" = không phải một khối đồng nhất; mỗi vai trò có mục tiêu riêng. Là danh từ, "uniform" nghĩa là đồng phục.
items.explanationEn: uniform /ˈjuː.nɪ.fɔːm/ (adjective): the same throughout. "Not a uniform block" means the team is not all alike; each role has its own goal. As a noun, "uniform" means clothing worn by a group.

items.question: Trong câu "BA, developer, and tester see the same feature through three different lenses", từ "lens" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA, developer, and tester see the same feature through three different lenses", what does "lens" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a piece of glass in a camera
a contact worn on the eye
items.explanation: lens /lenz/ (danh từ): góc nhìn, lăng kính. "See something through a lens" = nhìn nhận điều gì qua một góc nhìn riêng; nghĩa đen là thấu kính.
items.explanationEn: lens /lenz/ (noun): a way of viewing something. "See something through a lens" means viewing it from a particular perspective; literally, a lens is a curved piece of glass.

items.question: Trong câu "and understanding that is the first step to collaborating well.", từ "collaborate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and understanding that is the first step to collaborating well.", what does "collaborate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collaborate /kəˈlæb.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): hợp tác, cộng tác. "Collaborate with someone" = hợp tác với ai; danh từ: collaboration (sự cộng tác).
items.explanationEn: collaborate /kəˈlæb.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to work together. "Collaborate with someone" means work jointly with them; noun: collaboration.

items.question: Trong câu "Most team conflict is not somebody being deliberately difficult; it is these three goals colliding.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most team conflict is not somebody being deliberately difficult; it is these three goals colliding.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): cố ý, có chủ đích. "Deliberately difficult" = cố tình gây khó dễ. Tính từ: deliberate (có chủ ý).
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. "Deliberately difficult" means being awkward on purpose. Adjective: deliberate.

items.question: Trong câu "Most team conflict is not somebody being deliberately difficult; it is these three goals colliding.", từ "collide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most team conflict is not somebody being deliberately difficult; it is these three goals colliding.", what does "collide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (động từ): xung đột, va chạm nhau. "Goals colliding" = các mục tiêu xung đột nhau; nghĩa đen là hai vật đâm vào nhau. Danh từ: collision.
items.explanationEn: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (verb): to clash with each other. "Goals colliding" means goals clashing; literally, two objects hitting each other. Noun: collision.

items.question: Trong câu "Testers want clear criteria; the BA sometimes does not yet have enough information to supply them.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Testers want clear criteria; the BA sometimes does not yet have enough information to supply them.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
options: tiêu chí, tiêu chuẩn đánh giá
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí, tiêu chuẩn đánh giá. Số nhiều là "criteria"; "acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí chấp nhận của một user story.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (noun): a standard for judging something. The plural is "criteria"; "acceptance criteria" are the conditions a user story must meet.

items.question: Trong câu "What consumes time is:", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What consumes time is:", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): tiêu tốn, ngốn. "Consume time / memory" = tiêu tốn thời gian / bộ nhớ; nghĩa khác là ăn uống. Tính từ: time-consuming (tốn thời gian).
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to use up. "Consume time / memory" means use it up; another sense is to eat or drink. Adjective: time-consuming.

items.question: Trong câu "When developers understand why, they often propose a cheaper route to the same goal.", từ "propose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When developers understand why, they often propose a cheaper route to the same goal.", what does "propose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (động từ): đề xuất. "Propose a solution" = đề xuất giải pháp; danh từ: proposal (bản đề xuất).
items.explanationEn: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (verb): to suggest. "Propose a solution" means put it forward for consideration; noun: proposal.

items.question: Trong câu "When they only receive what, all they can do is follow the letter.", từ "follow the letter" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When they only receive what, all they can do is follow the letter.", what does "follow the letter" (phrase) mean?
options: làm đúng từng chữ, máy móc
optionsEn: to obey the exact wording only
items.explanation: follow the letter /ˈfɒl.əʊ ðə ˈlet.ə/ (cụm từ): làm đúng từng chữ, máy móc. "Follow the letter (of the requirement)" = làm đúng câu chữ mà không hiểu mục đích; đối lập với "the spirit" (tinh thần).
items.explanationEn: follow the letter /ˈfɒl.əʊ ðə ˈlet.ə/ (phrase): to obey the exact wording only. "Follow the letter" means doing exactly what the words say without grasping the intent; the opposite is following "the spirit".

items.question: Trong câu "Guessing is the worse failure mode.", từ "failure mode" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Guessing is the worse failure mode.", what does "failure mode" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: failure mode /ˈfeɪl.jə məʊd/ (cụm từ): kiểu thất bại, cách hỏng. "Failure mode" = dạng/cách mà một việc có thể hỏng; đoán mò là kiểu hỏng tệ hơn bị chặn.
items.explanationEn: failure mode /ˈfeɪl.jə məʊd/ (phrase): a way something goes wrong. A "failure mode" is a particular way things break down; guessing is worse than being blocked.

items.question: Trong câu "A mid-sprint change costs more than the same change next sprint, because of disruption and lost momentum.", từ "disruption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A mid-sprint change costs more than the same change next sprint, because of disruption and lost momentum.", what does "disruption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: disruption /dɪsˈrʌp.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự gián đoạn, xáo trộn. "Cause disruption" = gây xáo trộn công việc. Trong kinh doanh, "disruption" còn chỉ sự đổi mới làm thay đổi thị trường.
items.explanationEn: disruption /dɪsˈrʌp.ʃən/ (noun): an interruption that upsets progress. "Cause disruption" means upset normal work. In business it can also mean an innovation that shakes up a market.

items.question: Trong câu "A mid-sprint change costs more than the same change next sprint, because of disruption and lost momentum.", từ "momentum" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A mid-sprint change costs more than the same change next sprint, because of disruption and lost momentum.", what does "momentum" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: momentum /məˈmen.təm/ (danh từ): đà, nhịp tiến triển. "Lose / gain momentum" = mất / lấy đà. Trong vật lý, momentum là động lượng.
items.explanationEn: momentum /məˈmen.təm/ (noun): the drive of ongoing progress. "Lose / gain momentum" means lose or build the drive of progress. In physics it is mass times velocity.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not respond with suspicion.", từ "suspicion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not respond with suspicion.", what does "suspicion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: suspicion /səˈspɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): sự nghi ngờ. "Respond with suspicion" = đáp lại bằng thái độ nghi ngờ. Tính từ: suspicious (đáng ngờ / hay nghi ngờ).
items.explanationEn: suspicion /səˈspɪʃ.ən/ (noun): distrust. "Respond with suspicion" means react with distrust. Adjective: suspicious.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not specify the technical solution.", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not specify the technical solution.", what does "specify" (verb) mean?
options: quy định chi tiết, nêu cụ thể
items.explanation: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): quy định chi tiết, nêu cụ thể. "Specify a requirement" = nêu cụ thể yêu cầu; danh từ: specification (đặc tả, "spec").
items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to state in exact detail. "Specify a requirement" means state it precisely; noun: specification ("spec").

items.question: Trong câu "Do not promise on their behalf.", từ "on behalf of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not promise on their behalf.", what does "on behalf of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on behalf of /ɒn bɪˈhɑːf əv/ (cụm từ): thay mặt cho. "On someone's behalf" / "on behalf of someone" = thay mặt ai; BA không nên hứa thay đội dev.
items.explanationEn: on behalf of /ɒn bɪˈhɑːf əv/ (phrase): representing someone. "On someone's behalf" means acting for them; a BA should not promise for the dev team.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not forward a requirement you do not understand.", từ "forward" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not forward a requirement you do not understand.", what does "forward" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pass on to someone else
items.explanation: forward /ˈfɔː.wəd/ (động từ): chuyển tiếp (cho người khác). "Forward an email / a request" = chuyển tiếp thư / yêu cầu. Là trạng từ, "forward" nghĩa là về phía trước.
items.explanationEn: forward /ˈfɔː.wəd/ (verb): to pass on to someone else. "Forward an email / a request" means send it on. As an adverb, "forward" means toward the front.

items.question: Trong câu "That conversation is where a BA adds the most value — more than any document.", từ "add value" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That conversation is where a BA adds the most value — more than any document.", what does "add value" (phrase) mean?
options: tạo ra giá trị, đóng góp
items.explanation: add value /æd ˈvæl.juː/ (cụm từ): tạo ra giá trị, đóng góp. "Add value" = mang lại lợi ích thực sự; "value-added" = có giá trị gia tăng.
items.explanationEn: add value /æd ˈvæl.juː/ (phrase): to make a useful contribution. "Add value" means make a real, useful contribution; "value-added" describes something that does so.

items.question: Trong câu "Testers are the most commonly omitted group in requirements reviews, yet the most valuable one.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Testers are the most commonly omitted group in requirements reviews, yet the most valuable one.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ sót, bỏ qua. "Omitted from the review" = bị bỏ ra khỏi buổi review. Danh từ: omission (sự bỏ sót).
items.explanationEn: omit /əˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. "Omitted from the review" means left out of it. Noun: omission.

items.question: Trong câu "The reason: the testing mindset is an extremely effective defect filter applied to requirements.", từ "mindset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The reason: the testing mindset is an extremely effective defect filter applied to requirements.", what does "mindset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mindset /ˈmaɪnd.set/ (danh từ): tư duy, lối nghĩ. "Testing mindset" = lối tư duy của người kiểm thử: luôn tìm chỗ sai. Cụm hay gặp: growth mindset.
items.explanationEn: mindset /ˈmaɪnd.set/ (noun): a way of thinking. A "testing mindset" is the habit of looking for what can go wrong. Common phrase: growth mindset.

items.question: Trong câu "The reason: the testing mindset is an extremely effective defect filter applied to requirements.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The reason: the testing mindset is an extremely effective defect filter applied to requirements.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. "Log / fix a defect" = ghi nhận / sửa lỗi; trong kiểm thử, defect gần nghĩa với bug.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a fault or flaw. "Log / fix a defect" means record or repair a fault; in testing it is close to "bug".

items.question: Trong câu "A pragmatic rule: if a tester cannot write a test case from your requirement, a developer cannot build it correctly either.", từ "pragmatic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pragmatic rule: if a tester cannot write a test case from your requirement, a developer cannot build it correctly either.", what does "pragmatic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pragmatic /præɡˈmæt.ɪk/ (tính từ): thực tế, thiết thực. "A pragmatic approach" = cách tiếp cận thực tế, chú trọng hiệu quả hơn lý thuyết.
items.explanationEn: pragmatic /præɡˈmæt.ɪk/ (adjective): practical, sensible. "A pragmatic approach" focuses on what works in practice rather than on theory.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA brings business understanding, the tester brings exception-hunting instincts.", từ "instinct" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA brings business understanding, the tester brings exception-hunting instincts.", what does "instinct" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: instinct /ˈɪn.stɪŋkt/ (danh từ): bản năng, trực giác. "Exception-hunting instincts" = bản năng săn tìm trường hợp ngoại lệ. Tính từ: instinctive.
items.explanationEn: instinct /ˈɪn.stɪŋkt/ (noun): a natural feel for something. "Exception-hunting instincts" are a natural knack for finding edge cases. Adjective: instinctive.

items.question: Trong câu "Bring testers into grooming.", từ "grooming" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bring testers into grooming.", what does "grooming" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: grooming /ˈɡruː.mɪŋ/ (danh từ): buổi tinh chỉnh backlog. "Backlog grooming" (nay hay gọi là "refinement") = buổi làm rõ và ước lượng các item; nghĩa đời thường là chải chuốt.
items.explanationEn: grooming /ˈɡruː.mɪŋ/ (noun): refining the backlog. "Backlog grooming" (now often "refinement") clarifies and sizes items; in everyday English it means tidying one's appearance.

items.question: Trong câu "it is a new backlog item to be prioritized, not slipped quietly into the sprint.", từ "prioritize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it is a new backlog item to be prioritized, not slipped quietly into the sprint.", what does "prioritize" (verb) mean?
options: sắp xếp theo mức ưu tiên
items.explanation: prioritize /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (động từ): sắp xếp theo mức ưu tiên. "Prioritize the backlog" = sắp xếp backlog theo độ ưu tiên; danh từ: priority.
items.explanationEn: prioritize /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (verb): to rank by importance. "Prioritize the backlog" means order it by importance; noun: priority.

items.question: Trong câu "Confusing the two produces two bad outcomes: either the team is unfairly blamed for a missing requirement, or scope expands silently under the label of bug fixing.", từ "blame" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Confusing the two produces two bad outcomes: either the team is unfairly blamed for a missing requirement, or scope expands silently under the label of bug fixing.", what does "blame" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to hold responsible for a fault
items.explanation: blame /bleɪm/ (động từ): đổ lỗi. "Be blamed for something" = bị đổ lỗi vì điều gì; "take the blame" = nhận lỗi.
items.explanationEn: blame /bleɪm/ (verb): to hold responsible for a fault. "Be blamed for something" means be held responsible for it; "take the blame" means accept responsibility.

items.question: Trong câu "Confusing the two produces two bad outcomes: either the team is unfairly blamed for a missing requirement, or scope expands silently under the label of bug fixing.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Confusing the two produces two bad outcomes: either the team is unfairly blamed for a missing requirement, or scope expands silently under the label of bug fixing.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi công việc. "Scope creep" = phạm vi phình ra dần mà không kiểm soát. "Scope for improvement" dùng nghĩa khác: dư địa cải thiện.
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the extent of the work. "Scope creep" is uncontrolled growth of the work. "Scope for improvement" uses another sense: room to improve.

items.question: Trong câu "Confusing the two produces two bad outcomes: either the team is unfairly blamed for a missing requirement, or scope expands silently under the label of bug fixing.", từ "under the label of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Confusing the two produces two bad outcomes: either the team is unfairly blamed for a missing requirement, or scope expands silently under the label of bug fixing.", what does "under the label of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: under the label of /ˈʌn.də ðə ˈleɪ.bəl əv/ (cụm từ): dưới danh nghĩa. "Under the label of bug fixing" = núp dưới danh nghĩa sửa lỗi, trong khi thực chất là thêm yêu cầu mới.
items.explanationEn: under the label of /ˈʌn.də ðə ˈleɪ.bəl əv/ (phrase): disguised as. "Under the label of bug fixing" means passed off as bug fixing when it is really new scope.

items.question: Trong câu "Establish what the change really is.", từ "establish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Establish what the change really is.", what does "establish" (verb) mean?
options: xác định rõ, làm sáng tỏ
items.explanation: establish /ɪˈstæb.lɪʃ/ (động từ): xác định rõ, làm sáng tỏ. "Establish the facts" = xác minh sự thật; nghĩa khác: "establish a company" = thành lập công ty.
items.explanationEn: establish /ɪˈstæb.lɪʃ/ (verb): to find out for certain. "Establish the facts" means confirm them; another sense is "establish a company", to found it.

items.question: Trong câu "Many change requests turn out to be clarifications of something already implied", từ "turn out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many change requests turn out to be clarifications of something already implied", what does "turn out" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to prove to be in the end
items.explanation: turn out /tɜːn aʊt/ (cụm từ): hóa ra là. "Turn out to be X" = hóa ra là X; "turn out the light" lại là tắt đèn.
items.explanationEn: turn out /tɜːn aʊt/ (phrase): to prove to be in the end. "Turn out to be X" means be found to be X; "turn out the light" means switch it off.

items.question: Trong câu "Many change requests turn out to be clarifications of something already implied", từ "imply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many change requests turn out to be clarifications of something already implied", what does "imply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (động từ): ngụ ý, hàm ý. "Already implied" = đã được ngầm hiểu dù chưa viết ra. Danh từ: implication (hàm ý, hệ quả).
items.explanationEn: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (verb): to suggest without saying. "Already implied" means understood though never written down. Noun: implication.

items.question: Trong câu "Present the trade-off, not a refusal.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Present the trade-off, not a refusal.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Present the trade-off" = trình bày được gì mất gì, ví dụ thêm việc này thì việc kia lùi sang sprint sau.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two options. "Present the trade-off" means show what is gained and lost, e.g. adding this pushes that to the next sprint.

items.question: Trong câu "Record the decision with its rationale.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Record the decision with its rationale.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
options: lý do, cơ sở lập luận
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (danh từ): lý do, cơ sở lập luận. "The rationale behind a decision" = lý do đứng sau quyết định; nên ghi lại để sau này tra cứu.
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (noun): the reasoning behind it. "The rationale behind a decision" is the reasoning for it; record it so people can look it up later.

items.question: Trong câu "The boundary between clarification and scope change is the biggest source of dispute, especially on outsourced projects.", từ "dispute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The boundary between clarification and scope change is the biggest source of dispute, especially on outsourced projects.", what does "dispute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (danh từ): tranh chấp, bất đồng. "Settle / resolve a dispute" = giải quyết tranh chấp; hay gặp trong hợp đồng outsource.
items.explanationEn: dispute /dɪˈspjuːt/ (noun): a disagreement or conflict. "Settle / resolve a dispute" means end a disagreement; common in outsourcing contracts.

items.question: Trong câu "The boundary between clarification and scope change is the biggest source of dispute, especially on outsourced projects.", từ "outsource" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The boundary between clarification and scope change is the biggest source of dispute, especially on outsourced projects.", what does "outsource" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to contract work to another company
items.explanation: outsource /ˈaʊt.sɔːs/ (động từ): thuê ngoài, gia công. "Outsourced project" = dự án thuê một công ty bên ngoài làm; trái nghĩa: in-house (tự làm nội bộ).
items.explanationEn: outsource /ˈaʊt.sɔːs/ (verb): to contract work to another company. An "outsourced project" is done by an external company; the opposite is "in-house".

items.question: Trong câu "Define it beforehand, not once the dispute has erupted.", từ "beforehand" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define it beforehand, not once the dispute has erupted.", what does "beforehand" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: beforehand /bɪˈfɔː.hænd/ (trạng từ): từ trước. "Agree beforehand" = thống nhất từ trước; trái nghĩa: afterwards (sau đó).
items.explanationEn: beforehand /bɪˈfɔː.hænd/ (adverb): in advance. "Agree beforehand" means agree in advance; the opposite is "afterwards".

items.question: Trong câu "Define it beforehand, not once the dispute has erupted.", từ "erupt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define it beforehand, not once the dispute has erupted.", what does "erupt" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: erupt /ɪˈrʌpt/ (động từ): bùng nổ, nổ ra. "A dispute erupts" = tranh chấp bùng lên; nghĩa đen là núi lửa phun trào.
items.explanationEn: erupt /ɪˈrʌpt/ (verb): to break out suddenly. "A dispute erupts" means it breaks out suddenly; literally, a volcano erupts.

items.question: Trong câu "it is a genuine defect; the developer fixes it.", từ "genuine" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it is a genuine defect; the developer fixes it.", what does "genuine" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (tính từ): thật sự, đích thực. "A genuine defect" = lỗi thật sự (hệ thống làm sai so với yêu cầu), khác với chỗ yêu cầu còn thiếu.
items.explanationEn: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (adjective): real, true. A "genuine defect" is a real fault against the requirement, unlike a gap in the requirement.

items.question: Trong câu "not a defect in the contractual sense, but still a gap needing a decision.", từ "contractual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "not a defect in the contractual sense, but still a gap needing a decision.", what does "contractual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contractual /kənˈtræk.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): theo hợp đồng. "In the contractual sense" = xét theo hợp đồng; danh từ gốc: contract.
items.explanationEn: contractual /kənˈtræk.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): relating to a contract. "In the contractual sense" means judged by the contract; root noun: contract.

items.question: Trong câu "not a defect in the contractual sense, but still a gap needing a decision.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "not a defect in the contractual sense, but still a gap needing a decision.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): chỗ thiếu sót, lỗ hổng. "A gap in the requirements" = phần yêu cầu còn thiếu; "gap analysis" = phân tích khoảng cách hiện trạng – mục tiêu.
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): a missing part. "A gap in the requirements" is something they fail to cover; "gap analysis" compares current and target states.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 2 — For a gap, ask: is the current behaviour acceptable?", từ "acceptable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 2 — For a gap, ask: is the current behaviour acceptable?", what does "acceptable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: acceptable /əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chấp nhận được. "Acceptable behaviour" = hành vi chấp nhận được; động từ: accept; "acceptance testing" = kiểm thử chấp nhận.
items.explanationEn: acceptable /əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (adjective): good enough to allow. "Acceptable behaviour" is good enough to keep; verb: accept; "acceptance testing" checks this.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 3 — Extract the lesson.", từ "extract" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 3 — Extract the lesson.", what does "extract" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (động từ): rút ra. "Extract a lesson / insight" = rút ra bài học; nghĩa khác: "extract data" = trích xuất dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (verb): to draw out a conclusion. "Extract a lesson" means draw one out of an experience; "extract data" means pull data from a source.

items.question: Trong câu "that is a process signal: the BA needs to cover exception cases better during grooming.", từ "signal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "that is a process signal: the BA needs to cover exception cases better during grooming.", what does "signal" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a sign that something needs attention
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu cảnh báo. "A process signal" = dấu hiệu cho thấy quy trình có vấn đề; "send a signal" = gửi tín hiệu / thông điệp.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (noun): a sign that something needs attention. A "process signal" is a sign that the process needs fixing; "send a signal" means convey a message.

items.question: Trong câu "The most important thing: do not let the argument become a hunt for who is at fault.", từ "at fault" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important thing: do not let the argument become a hunt for who is at fault.", what does "at fault" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at fault /æt fɔːlt/ (cụm từ): có lỗi, chịu trách nhiệm. "Who is at fault" = ai có lỗi; buổi review nên tránh "blame game" (đổ lỗi qua lại).
items.explanationEn: at fault /æt fɔːlt/ (phrase): to blame for a problem. "Who is at fault" asks who is to blame; reviews should avoid a "blame game".

items.question: Trong câu "Many conflicts are really boundary conflicts rather than content disagreements.", từ "disagreement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many conflicts are really boundary conflicts rather than content disagreements.", what does "disagreement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: disagreement /ˌdɪs.əˈɡriː.mənt/ (danh từ): sự bất đồng ý kiến. "Content disagreement" = bất đồng về nội dung; "resolve a disagreement" = giải quyết bất đồng.
items.explanationEn: disagreement /ˌdɪs.əˈɡriː.mənt/ (noun): a difference of opinion. A "content disagreement" is about the substance; "resolve a disagreement" means settle it.

items.question: Trong câu "The Product Owner / customer, with BA input", từ "input" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Product Owner / customer, with BA input", what does "input" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (danh từ): ý kiến đóng góp. "With BA input" = có ý kiến đóng góp của BA; trong lập trình "input" là dữ liệu đầu vào.
items.explanationEn: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (noun): a contribution of ideas. "With BA input" means with the BA's advice; in programming, "input" is data fed in.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA, after clarifying with the authority", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA, after clarifying with the authority", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): người có thẩm quyền. "Clarify with the authority" = làm rõ với người có quyền quyết định; "authorities" (số nhiều) thường là chính quyền.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): the person entitled to decide. "Clarify with the authority" means check with whoever may decide; "the authorities" usually means government.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA estimating on the team's behalf.", từ "estimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA estimating on the team's behalf.", what does "estimate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (động từ): ước lượng, ước tính. Danh từ đọc /ˈes.tɪ.mət/; "effort estimates" = ước lượng công sức, việc này thuộc về đội phát triển chứ không phải BA.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (verb): to roughly calculate. The noun is pronounced /ˈes.tɪ.mət/; "effort estimates" belong to the development team, not the BA.

items.question: Trong câu "Whether quality is good enough to ship", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whether quality is good enough to ship", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành (sản phẩm). "Good enough to ship" = đủ tốt để phát hành cho người dùng; nghĩa gốc là vận chuyển bằng tàu.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release a product. "Good enough to ship" means ready to release to users; the original sense is to send by boat.

items.question: Trong câu "The whole team, per the definition of done", từ "per" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The whole team, per the definition of done", what does "per" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: per /pɜː/ (giới từ): theo, căn cứ vào. "Per the definition of done" = căn cứ theo định nghĩa hoàn thành; nghĩa khác: "per sprint" = mỗi sprint.
items.explanationEn: per /pɜː/ (preposition): according to. "Per the definition of done" means according to it; another sense: "per sprint" means for each sprint.

items.question: Trong câu "and the BA answers immediately, you just committed for the people who must do the work.", từ "commit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and the BA answers immediately, you just committed for the people who must do the work.", what does "commit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (động từ): cam kết, hứa chắc. "Commit to a deadline" = cam kết hạn chót; trong Git, "commit" là lưu thay đổi; "commit a crime" = phạm tội.
items.explanationEn: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (verb): to promise to deliver. "Commit to a deadline" means promise it; in Git a commit saves changes; "commit a crime" means do wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "When a requirement is ambiguous and a developer picks a handling, a business decision is being made by someone without business context.", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a requirement is ambiguous and a developer picks a handling, a business decision is being made by someone without business context.", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: open to more than one meaning
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, đa nghĩa. "An ambiguous requirement" = yêu cầu hiểu được nhiều cách; danh từ: ambiguity.
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (adjective): open to more than one meaning. An "ambiguous requirement" can be read in several ways; noun: ambiguity.

items.question: Trong câu "When a requirement is ambiguous and a developer picks a handling, a business decision is being made by someone without business context.", từ "context" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a requirement is ambiguous and a developer picks a handling, a business decision is being made by someone without business context.", what does "context" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: context /ˈkɒn.tekst/ (danh từ): bối cảnh, hiểu biết nền. "Business context" = hiểu biết về bối cảnh nghiệp vụ; "out of context" = tách khỏi ngữ cảnh.
items.explanationEn: context /ˈkɒn.tekst/ (noun): background understanding. "Business context" is background knowledge of the business; "out of context" means stripped of surroundings.

items.question: Trong câu "Four habits that make a large difference:", từ "make a difference" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four habits that make a large difference:", what does "make a difference" (phrase) mean?
options: tạo ra khác biệt, có tác động
items.explanation: make a difference /meɪk ə ˈdɪf.ər.əns/ (cụm từ): tạo ra khác biệt, có tác động. "Make a big / large difference" = tạo khác biệt lớn; "make no difference" = chẳng ảnh hưởng gì.
items.explanationEn: make a difference /meɪk ə ˈdɪf.ər.əns/ (phrase): to have a real effect. "Make a big difference" means have a strong effect; "make no difference" means have none.

items.question: Trong câu "Be present and available.", từ "available" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Be present and available.", what does "available" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: available /əˈveɪ.lə.bəl/ (tính từ): sẵn sàng, liên lạc được. "Be available" (với người) = rảnh, có thể liên hệ; với hàng hóa = còn hàng, có sẵn.
items.explanationEn: available /əˈveɪ.lə.bəl/ (adjective): free to be contacted. For a person, "available" means free to talk; for goods, it means in stock.

items.question: Trong câu "Most of the value a BA creates during a sprint comes from answering questions promptly.", từ "promptly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most of the value a BA creates during a sprint comes from answering questions promptly.", what does "promptly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: promptly /ˈprɒmpt.li/ (trạng từ): nhanh chóng, kịp thời. "Reply promptly" = trả lời ngay; tính từ: prompt (nhanh chóng). Là danh từ, "prompt" là câu lệnh gợi ý.
items.explanationEn: promptly /ˈprɒmpt.li/ (adverb): quickly, without delay. "Reply promptly" means answer without delay; adjective: prompt. As a noun, a prompt is a cue or instruction.

items.question: Trong câu "A brilliant BA nobody can reach helps nobody.", từ "reach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A brilliant BA nobody can reach helps nobody.", what does "reach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reach /riːtʃ/ (động từ): liên lạc được với. "Can't reach someone" = không liên lạc được với ai; "reach a goal" = đạt mục tiêu.
items.explanationEn: reach /riːtʃ/ (verb): to contact. "Can't reach someone" means unable to contact them; "reach a goal" means achieve it.

items.question: Trong câu "Admit when you do not know.", từ "admit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Admit when you do not know.", what does "admit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (động từ): thừa nhận. "Admit a mistake" = thừa nhận sai lầm; "admit to hospital" = nhập viện (nghĩa cho vào).
items.explanationEn: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (verb): to confess to be true. "Admit a mistake" means own up to it; "admitted to hospital" uses the sense of letting in.

items.question: Trong câu "I am not sure — let me check and get back to you today", từ "get back to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "I am not sure — let me check and get back to you today", what does "get back to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: get back to /ɡet bæk tuː/ (cụm từ): phản hồi lại sau. "I'll get back to you" = tôi sẽ phản hồi lại anh/chị sau; câu rất hay dùng trong công sở.
items.explanationEn: get back to /ɡet bæk tuː/ (phrase): to reply to later. "I'll get back to you" means I will reply later; a very common workplace phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "builds more credibility than a confident guess that turns out wrong.", từ "credibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "builds more credibility than a confident guess that turns out wrong.", what does "credibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credibility /ˌkred.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): uy tín, sự đáng tin. "Build / lose credibility" = xây dựng / mất uy tín; tính từ: credible (đáng tin).
items.explanationEn: credibility /ˌkred.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): trustworthiness. "Build / lose credibility" means gain or lose people's trust; adjective: credible.

items.question: Trong câu "Shield the team when needed.", từ "shield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Shield the team when needed.", what does "shield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shield /ʃiːld/ (động từ): che chắn, bảo vệ. "Shield someone from pressure" = che chắn ai khỏi áp lực; danh từ "shield" là cái khiên.
items.explanationEn: shield /ʃiːld/ (verb): to protect. "Shield someone from pressure" means protect them; as a noun, a shield is a piece of armour.

items.question: Trong câu "the BA should explain the impact rather than staying silent and leaving the team to cope.", từ "cope" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the BA should explain the impact rather than staying silent and leaving the team to cope.", what does "cope" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cope /kəʊp/ (động từ): xoay xở, đương đầu. "Cope with pressure" = xoay xở với áp lực; "leave someone to cope" = để ai tự xoay xở.
items.explanationEn: cope /kəʊp/ (verb): to manage a difficulty. "Cope with pressure" means deal with it; "leave someone to cope" means let them struggle alone.

items.question: Trong câu "Give credit publicly.", từ "give credit" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Give credit publicly.", what does "give credit" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: give credit /ɡɪv ˈkred.ɪt/ (cụm từ): ghi nhận công lao. "Give someone credit for something" = ghi nhận công của ai; "credit" trong ngân hàng là tín dụng.
items.explanationEn: give credit /ɡɪv ˈkred.ɪt/ (phrase): to acknowledge someone's work. "Give someone credit for something" means acknowledge their contribution; in banking, credit is borrowed money.

items.question: Trong câu "When a developer spots a gap in the requirements, say so in the review.", từ "spot" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a developer spots a gap in the requirements, say so in the review.", what does "spot" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spot /spɒt/ (động từ): phát hiện, nhận ra. "Spot a mistake" = phát hiện lỗi; là danh từ, "spot" là chấm, vết hoặc địa điểm.
items.explanationEn: spot /spɒt/ (verb): to notice. "Spot a mistake" means notice it; as a noun, a spot is a dot, a stain or a place.

items.question: Trong câu "The best relationship indicator: developers and testers come to you before deciding for themselves.", từ "indicator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best relationship indicator: developers and testers come to you before deciding for themselves.", what does "indicator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a sign that shows a state
items.explanation: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tə/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu, chỉ báo. "Key performance indicator" (KPI) = chỉ số hiệu suất chính; ở Anh, "indicator" còn là đèn xi-nhan.
items.explanationEn: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tə/ (noun): a sign that shows a state. A "key performance indicator" (KPI) measures success; in British English it is also a car's turn signal.

items.question: Trong câu "Most conflict is not deliberate obstruction but these three goals colliding.", từ "obstruction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most conflict is not deliberate obstruction but these three goals colliding.", what does "obstruction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: obstruction /əbˈstrʌk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự cản trở. "Deliberate obstruction" = cố tình cản trở; động từ: obstruct.
items.explanationEn: obstruction /əbˈstrʌk.ʃən/ (noun): blocking progress. "Deliberate obstruction" means blocking on purpose; verb: obstruct.

items.question: Trong câu "What developers need most: clarity on exceptions, the reason behind the requirement, timely answers, sprint stability.", từ "timely" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What developers need most: clarity on exceptions, the reason behind the requirement, timely answers, sprint stability.", what does "timely" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: timely /ˈtaɪm.li/ (tính từ): kịp thời, đúng lúc. "A timely answer" = câu trả lời kịp lúc; dù có đuôi -ly nhưng "timely" là tính từ.
items.explanationEn: timely /ˈtaɪm.li/ (adjective): happening at the right time. "A timely answer" arrives when it is needed; despite the -ly ending, "timely" is an adjective.

items.question: Trong câu "Confusing the two produces unfair blame or silent scope expansion under the label of bug fixing.", từ "expansion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Confusing the two produces unfair blame or silent scope expansion under the label of bug fixing.", what does "expansion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: expansion /ɪkˈspæn.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự mở rộng, phình ra. "Scope expansion" = phạm vi phình to; động từ: expand.
items.explanationEn: expansion /ɪkˈspæn.ʃən/ (noun): growth in size. "Scope expansion" means the work growing larger; verb: expand.

items.question: Trong câu "With QC, jointly written acceptance criteria and correct defect classification are the two key collaboration points.", từ "jointly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With QC, jointly written acceptance criteria and correct defect classification are the two key collaboration points.", what does "jointly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: jointly /ˈdʒɔɪnt.li/ (trạng từ): cùng nhau, chung. "Jointly written" = cùng nhau viết; "joint decision" = quyết định chung.
items.explanationEn: jointly /ˈdʒɔɪnt.li/ (adverb): together. "Jointly written" means written together; a "joint decision" is shared.

items.question: Trong câu "When disagreement arises, separate the problem from the person", từ "arise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When disagreement arises, separate the problem from the person", what does "arise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: arise /əˈraɪz/ (động từ): nảy sinh, xuất hiện. "When problems arise" = khi vấn đề nảy sinh; quá khứ: arose, arisen.
items.explanationEn: arise /əˈraɪz/ (verb): to come up, to occur. "When problems arise" means when they come up; past forms: arose, arisen.
